title: Jev with Foresight: Safe Language-Guided Autonomous Driving via a Language World Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.05448v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models understand passengers' driving commands, but as driving agents they reason in generated text for seconds and must infer each action's consequences implicitly from the scene. We present Jev-AD, which pairs Jev, a typed decision model that answers predefined questions with probabilities, not generated text, with a language world model that predicts for every candidate action how nearby vehicles move over the next two seconds. Code turns these predictions into foreseen consequences, which Jev compares instead of inferring them from coordinates. In simulated highway merging (500 car-episodes), this foresight lowers the same decision model's collision rate from 26.0% to 2.4% at 0.25 seconds per decision, and Jev-AD achieves the passenger's intent in 93% of free-form command trials. translated_title: 具有前瞻能力的Jev：通过语言世界模型实现安全的语言引导自动驾驶
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型能够理解乘客的驾驶指令，但作为驾驶智能体，它们需要花费数秒钟在生成的文本中进行推理，并且必须从场景中隐式推断每个动作的后果。我们提出了Jev-AD，它将Jev（一种类型化决策模型，以概率而非生成文本的形式回答预定义问题）与语言世界模型相结合，该世界模型为每个候选动作预测附近车辆在未来两秒内的运动。代码将这些预测转化为可预见的结果，Jev可以直接比较这些结果，而无需从坐标中推断。在模拟高速公路汇入场景（500个车辆回合）中，这种前瞻能力将同一决策模型的碰撞率从26.0%降至2.4%，每次决策仅需0.25秒，并且Jev-AD在93%的自由形式指令试验中实现了乘客的意图。在500个重放的真实世界NGSIM回合中，前瞻能力将碰撞率从48.2%降至2.8%，并且从这些数据中学习得到的世界模型……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Jev-AD系统，通过将基于概率回答的类型化决策模型Jev与能预测候选动作后果的语言世界模型相结合，实现了前瞻式安全决策，将模拟场景碰撞率从26.0%降至2.4%、真实NGSIM数据碰撞率从48.2%降至2.8%，同时能理解并实现乘客的自由形式驾驶指令。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Jev-AD, which pairs a typed decision model (Jev) that answers questions with probabilities with a language world model that foresees the consequences of candidate actions, reducing collision rates from 26.0% to 2.4% in simulation and from 48.2% to 2.8% on real NGSIM data while achieving passengers' free-form driving intent.
